title: Retrieve relevant production guidance before rewriting prompts
summary: Research found benefits of retrieval-augmented text-to-music prompt rewriting on Stable Audio 2.0; treat transfer to Suno as an untested hypothesis. Retrieve source-linked guidance and preserve user intention.

build.target: Retrieve cited SunOmega production knowledge before creating a song brief and avoid unsupported prompt folklore.
requires: Local SunOmega records or a read-only knowledge adapter
outputs: Relevant records with status, source and applicability
A concise prioritized brief and unresolved evidence gaps
execute: Search titles, summaries, build targets and matchup applicability, using alternative musical terms when needed.
Rank relevant provider capabilities above community hypotheses for API behavior.
Inspect source IDs, status, restrictions, negative evidence and steps of candidate builds.
Select an applicable approach without acting on inaccessible or unapproved tools.
Show selected techniques with source links and uncertainty; record retrieval misses.

applies_when: A task resembles an existing issue such as rushed vocals or a flat chorus.
The agent is unsure which Suno operation or prompt strategy applies.
avoid_when: No repository access is available and the requested facts are not in the current context.
Retrieved entry is deprecated or conflicts with the user's explicit requirement.

operator: Reading a build never grants authority to execute it.
Do not pretend substring matching is semantic retrieval.

stop_when: Relevant sourced guidance has been retrieved or no justified match can be found.

checks: Each recommendation links to an actual record/source.
Evaluate retrieval against a held-out natural-language query set.
